content: There are four steps to build the ancient-modern Chinese translation dataset: (i) The parallel corpus crawling and cleaning. (ii) The paragraph alignment. (iii) The clause alignment based on aligned paragraphs. (iv) Augmenting data by merging aligned adjacent clauses. The most critical step is the third step.
